passages.text: Investors should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements based upon current expectations that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those discussed in the section titled “ Risk Factors” and in other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. See also the section titled “Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” in this report. Our fiscal year end is the first Sunday after January 30. The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations covers fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025 items and year-over-year comparisons between fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025. Discussions of fiscal 2024 items and year-over-year comparisons between fiscal 2025 and 2024 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended February 2, 2025, that was filed with the SEC on March 27, 2025. Overview Everpure, formerly known as Pure Storage, is a global technology company providing an integrated storage and data management platform. Data is foundational to our customers’ business transformation and increasingly central to their operational resilience and competitive differentiation. As data volumes expand and artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more deeply embedded in customers' operations, the ability to store, manage, govern, and derive greater value from their data is becoming as important as the infrastructure used to store it. We began as a provider of flash-based storage systems. Over time, we have evolved into a company that delivers a cloud experience with an intelligent, unified storage and data management platform (the Everpure Platform) that virtualizes data across on-premises, hybrid, public cloud, and edge environments into a single storage layer with consistent control, built-in automation and continuous modernization. We are executing a focused strategy to modernize and simplify data center infrastructure for customers as AI adoption increases and power, space, and operational constraints intensify. Our vision of an all-flash data center integrates our foundation of simplicity and reliability with four major market trends that are impacting all organizations: (1) the shift towards modernizing data infrastructure with all-flash technology; (2) the growth of modern cloud-native applications; (3) increasing demand for data storage delivered as a service; and (4) increasing demand for data storage to support accelerating AI adoption while managing rising energy costs. passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: Revolving Credit Facility In June 2025, we entered into a Credit Agreement with a consortium of financial institutions and lenders that provides for a five-year , senior unsecured revolving credit facility of $ 500.0 million (Credit Facility) that expires on June 10, 2030, unless otherwise extended. Proceeds from borrowings under the Credit Facility may be used for general corporate purposes and working capital. The Credit Facility replaced our prior $ 300.0 million revolving credit facility in which the outstanding borrowings of $ 100.0 million was repaid in full and terminated effective June 10, 2025. The interest expense incurred during fiscal 2024, 2025, and 2026 under the prior revolving credit facility was not material. U.S. Dollar denominated borrowings under the Credit Facility will bear interest, at our option, at a base rate, subject to a floor of 0 %, plus a margin ranging from 0 % to 0.50 %, or the term SOFR (based on one, three or six-month interest periods), subject to a floor of 0 %, plus a margin ranging from 0.875 % to 1.50 %. Interest is payable quarterly in arrears with respect to base rate borrowings and at the end of the interest period with respect to term SOFR borrowing. We are also obligated to pay an ongoing commitment fee on undrawn amounts at a rate ranging from 0.075 % to 0.20 % per annum, payable quarterly in arrears. The respective margins will fluctuate based on the then-applicable Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) and, if available, our debt rating. We are subject to certain affirmative and negative covenants, including a Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio not to exceed 3.5 :1 (which may be increased to 4 :1 for the first six consecutive fiscal quarters after a qualified acquisition, as defined in the Credit Agreement) measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter. As of the end of fiscal 2026, there were no outstanding borrowings and we were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Facility. Convertible Senior Notes In April 2023, we repaid the entire $ 575.0 million principal balance of our 0.125 % convertible senior, unsecured notes (the Notes) that were issued in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers in April 2018. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure comfortably, leaving substantial free cash flow after funding the asset-light storage platform and its subscription transition. This internally generated liquidity, rather than borrowed money, funds working capital and product development, so the issuer's growth is not dependent on external financing and cash generation remains the primary source of financial flexibility.

The balance sheet carries a large unrestricted cash position against a current ratio above the sector median, and the revolving facility is undrawn with no funded borrowings outstanding. Liquidity therefore comfortably absorbs contractual purchase obligations and lease commitments without drawing on committed lines, supporting a strong short-term repayment profile.

key_risks.text: The issuer's own risk disclosure flags dependence on expanding sales with its current hyperscale customer and on winning new hyperscale design wins, alongside a shift toward subscription and as-a-service revenue. Concentration in a small number of very large customers makes revenue timing and renewal outcomes volatile, which could pressure operating cash flow precisely when capital commitments are fixed.

The debt note shows the prior revolver's outstanding borrowings were repaid and replaced by a larger senior unsecured facility maturing in the medium term, with pricing tied to a leverage-based grid and a covenant ceiling on consolidated net leverage. Undrawn capacity is not permanent funding, and a qualified acquisition could temporarily raise the permitted ceiling, so refinancing and covenant headroom depend on continued earnings delivery.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is exceptionally high and well above the sector median, reflecting minimal reported interest expense against solid operating income. With no funded debt outstanding at year end, debt service currently consumes a negligible share of earnings, and the undrawn revolver's commitment fees are immaterial, so coverage has substantial headroom even if rates rise.

Free cash flow is strong relative to the modest contractual obligations disclosed, and cash on hand exceeds current liabilities. However, total debt could not be assembled from reported tags, so leverage and free-cash-flow-to-debt ratios cannot be computed; this data gap is material because it prevents a definitive view on gross and net leverage versus the sector median.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a low-leverage, cash-rich profile: revenue and operating income have grown steadily, operating margin is below the sector median but improving, and cash generation funds capital spending and shareholder distributions. With the revolver undrawn and no funded debt, credit quality rests on business execution rather than financial engineering, and the indicative risk profile is constrained only by missing debt data.

Analyst judgement: the credit should remain investment-grade-like absent a leveraged acquisition or a sharp hyperscale demand reversal. Shareholder buybacks absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow, so discretionary returns compete with liquidity build; monitoring should focus on customer concentration, subscription revenue mix, and any future revolver draw that would reintroduce leverage.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋資本開支，在為輕資產存儲平台及其訂閱制轉型提供資金後，仍留下可觀的自由現金流。此內部產生的流動性，而非借入資金，為營運資金及產品開發提供資金，因此發行人的增長並不依賴外部融資，現金產生能力仍是財務靈活性的主要來源。
資產負債表持有龐大的未受限現金，流動比率高於行業中位數，而循環融資額度尚未動用，並無已提取借款未償還。因此流動性足以輕鬆吸納合約採購義務及租賃承擔，而無需動用已承諾額度，支持強勁的短期還款狀況。

key_risks.text: 發行人自身的風險披露指出，其依賴與現有超大規模客戶擴大銷售，以及依賴贏得新的超大規模設計訂單，同時亦面對向訂閱及服務化收入轉移的趨勢。收入集中於少數極大型客戶，令收入確認時間及續約結果波動，可能在資本承擔固定的時候對營運現金流構成壓力。
債務附註顯示，先前循環融資的未償還借款已償還，並由一項規模更大、於中期到期的優先無抵押融資取代，定價與基於槓桿的網格掛鈎，並設有合併淨槓桿的契約上限。未動用額度並非永久資金來源，而一項合資格收購可能暫時提高允許上限，因此再融資及契約空間取決於持續的盈利表現。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率極高，遠高於行業中位數，反映相對於穩健的營運收入，呈報利息開支極少。由於年末並無已提取債務未償還，債務償付目前僅佔盈利的微不足道部分，而未動用循環融資的承諾費亦不重大，因此即使利率上升，覆蓋率仍有充裕空間。
相對於所披露的有限合約義務，自由現金流強勁，而手頭現金超過流動負債。然而，總債務無法從呈報標籤中彙集，因此無法計算槓桿及自由現金流對債務比率；此數據缺口屬重大，因其妨礙對總槓桿及淨槓桿相對行業中位數作出確定性看法。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現低槓桿、現金充裕的狀況：收入及營運收入穩步增長，營運利潤率低於行業中位數但正在改善，而現金產生為資本開支及股東分派提供資金。由於循環融資未動用且並無已提取債務，信貸質素取決於業務執行而非財務工程，而指示性風險狀況僅受缺失債務數據所限制。
分析師判斷：在沒有槓桿收購或超大規模需求急劇逆轉的情況下，該信貸應保持類投資級。股東回購吸收自由現金流的相當部分，因此酌情回報與流動性累積互相競爭；監測應聚焦於客戶集中度、訂閱收入組合，以及任何未來循環融資提取，因其將重新引入槓桿。
